database.name: Commercial Insurance
database.description: Harborline Insurance Group, Global Commercial reporting. A commercial property & casualty book written through six legal entities in North America and internationally: about 5,000 policies, 800 multinational clients, 11 coverages in 8 lines of business, and 9,110 claims. One KPI fact table (TFACT_KPI) holds premium, expense, financial-income and loss amounts, surrounded by eight conformed dimensions. Currency is USD. Data covers July 2023 to June 2026 as 36 monthly valuation snapshots (month-end dates); complete years are 2024 and 2025 (2023 is July-December only, 2026 is January-June only). Fiscal year = calendar year. Premium, commission, expense and financial amounts are monthly flows that add up over time. Loss amounts (incurred, paid, outstanding reserve, claim expense) are cumulative balances restated at every snapshot: they must never be added across snapshots.

tables.description: Conformed calendar, one row per day from 2020-01-01 to 2026-12-31. TFACT_KPI joins to it three times, in three roles: Snapshot date (the month-end valuation the row belongs to), Fiscal date (the fiscal month-end the premium or expense is booked in) and Accident date (the month-end of the accident, for losses; premium rows carry their fiscal month-end here so earned premium lines up by accident period). Hierarchy for every role: Year > Quarter > Month > Day. Fiscal year = calendar year.

tables.description: Global Commercial KPI fact, at a monthly grain. Two kinds of rows share the table. Premium rows (DIM_CLAIM_ID empty, 67,037 rows): one per policy coverage per fiscal month, carrying written and earned premium, commission, underwriting expense, investment income, other financial revenue and tax; these are monthly flows that add up over time. Loss rows (DIM_CLAIM_ID set, 152,483 rows): one per claim per monthly valuation snapshot, carrying incurred loss, paid loss, outstanding reserve and claim expense as cumulative balances to date; every snapshot restates the full balance, so loss amounts must never be added across snapshots. CURRENT_VALUATION_IN = 'Y' marks rows from the latest snapshot (2026-06-30), which hold every claim's current balance. Date roles: snapshot date (valuation month), fiscal month-end (booking month), accident month-end (accident month for loss rows; the fiscal month for premium rows, so earned premium lines up by accident period).

metrics.description: Average gross premium per policy coverage written. Definition: Gross Written Premium / Policies Written. Ratio: compute from the totals.
metrics.name: Average Written Premium

metrics.description: Claims reported. Definition: SUM(CLAIM_COUNT). Each claim is counted once, in the snapshot it was first reported, so it adds up over time and across all dimensions.
metrics.name: Claim Count

metrics.description: Claim handling (loss adjustment) expense at the current valuation. Definition: SUM(CLAIM_EXPENSE_AMT) WHERE CURRENT_VALUATION_IN = 'Y'. Reads only the latest snapshot.
metrics.name: Claim Expense

metrics.description: The headline underwriting KPI. Definition: Loss Ratio + Expense Ratio. Below 100% is an underwriting profit; above 100% is a loss. Accident-year basis like the Loss Ratio. Compute each ratio from totals, then add them.
metrics.name: Combined Ratio

metrics.description: Commission as a share of earned premium. Definition: Net Commission / Net Earned Premium. Ratio: compute from the totals.
metrics.name: Commission Ratio

metrics.description: Underwriting expense as a share of written premium. Definition: Underwriting Expense / Net Written Premium. Ratio: compute from the totals.
metrics.name: Expense Ratio

metrics.description: Gross premium written. Definition: SUM(GROSS_WRITTEN_PREMIUM_AMT). Adds up over time; report it by the fiscal month-end date. Also report it year-over-year and year-to-date on the fiscal calendar: prior-year value, YoY growth % = (this period - same period last year) / same period last year, and year-to-date total.
metrics.name: Gross Written Premium

metrics.description: Incurred loss at the current valuation. Definition: SUM(INCURRED_LOSS_AMT) WHERE CURRENT_VALUATION_IN = 'Y'. Reads only the latest snapshot, so it adds across claims, coverages, lines, locations and clients and can never double count. Slice it by the accident date to see losses by accident year. This is the incurred loss in the loss ratio.
metrics.name: Incurred Loss

metrics.description: Incurred loss as of a valuation snapshot, for reserve-development and year-end views. Definition: SUM(INCURRED_LOSS_AMT). Rule: point-in-time balance on the snapshot date. For any period (month, quarter, year), take the balance from the latest snapshot in that period; add across claims, lines and locations, never across snapshots. Example: the 2025 value is the December 2025 snapshot.
metrics.name: Incurred Loss Balance

metrics.description: Investment income allocated to the business. Definition: SUM(INVESTMENT_INCOME_AMT). Adds up over time.
metrics.name: Investment Income

metrics.description: Investment income as a share of earned premium. Definition: Investment Income / Net Earned Premium. Ratio: compute from the totals.
metrics.name: Investment Income Ratio

metrics.description: Incurred loss as a share of earned premium, on an accident-year basis. Definition: Incurred Loss (current valuation) / Net Earned Premium. Report by the accident date: premium rows carry their earning month as the accident date, so each accident period's losses are divided by that period's earned premium. Ratio: compute from the totals, never average the ratios. Recent accident years are still developing and read lower.
metrics.name: Loss Ratio

metrics.description: Broker commission expense. Definition: SUM(NET_COMMISSION_AMT). Adds up over time.
metrics.name: Net Commission

metrics.description: Net premium earned. Definition: SUM(NET_EARNED_PREMIUM_AMT). Adds up over time. The denominator of the loss, commission and combined ratios. Also report it year-over-year on the fiscal calendar.
metrics.name: Net Earned Premium

metrics.description: Bottom-line result. Definition: Underwriting Result + Investment Income + Other Financial Revenue - Tax and Other Expense. Accident-year basis like the Loss Ratio: report by the accident date.
metrics.name: Net Result

metrics.description: Written premium net of reinsurance. Definition: SUM(NET_WRITTEN_PREMIUM_AMT). Adds up over time; report it by the fiscal month-end date. Also report it year-over-year on the fiscal calendar.
metrics.name: Net Written Premium

metrics.description: Combined ratio after investment income. Definition: Combined Ratio - Investment Income Ratio. Below 100% means the business is profitable once investment income is counted.
metrics.name: Operating Ratio

metrics.description: Other financial revenue. Definition: SUM(OTHER_FINANCIAL_REVENUE_AMT). Adds up over time.
metrics.name: Other Financial Revenue

metrics.description: Case reserves outstanding at the current valuation. Definition: SUM(OUTSTANDING_RESERVE_AMT) WHERE CURRENT_VALUATION_IN = 'Y'. Reads only the latest snapshot.
metrics.name: Outstanding Reserve

metrics.description: Case reserves as of a valuation snapshot. Definition: SUM(OUTSTANDING_RESERVE_AMT). Rule: point-in-time balance on the snapshot date; take the latest snapshot in the period, never add across snapshots.
metrics.name: Outstanding Reserve Balance

metrics.description: Paid loss at the current valuation. Definition: SUM(PAID_LOSS_AMT) WHERE CURRENT_VALUATION_IN = 'Y'. Reads only the latest snapshot.
metrics.name: Paid Loss

metrics.description: Paid loss as of a valuation snapshot. Definition: SUM(PAID_LOSS_AMT). Rule: point-in-time balance on the snapshot date; take the latest snapshot in the period, never add across snapshots.
metrics.name: Paid Loss Balance

metrics.description: Reserve-adequacy signal: how much of incurred loss has been paid. Definition: Paid Loss / Incurred Loss, both at the current valuation. Low values on long-tail coverages are expected; a low value that stays low as the accident year matures can signal adverse development. Ratio: compute from the totals.
metrics.name: Paid to Incurred Ratio
metrics.query_description: Commercial KPI (monthly), Paid to Incurred Ratio

metrics.description: Policy coverages written (incepted) in the period. Definition: COUNT of rows WHERE GROSS_WRITTEN_PREMIUM_AMT > 0. Adds up over time; report it by the fiscal month-end date.
metrics.name: Policies Written

metrics.description: Number of distinct policies with activity in the period. Definition: COUNT(DISTINCT DIM_POLICY_ID). Not additive: count distinct policies over the whole period, never add monthly counts.
metrics.name: Policies in Force

metrics.description: Share of gross premium kept after reinsurance. Definition: Net Written Premium / Gross Written Premium. Ratio: compute from the totals, never average the ratios.
metrics.name: Retention Ratio

metrics.description: Premium taxes and other expense. Definition: SUM(TAX_AND_OTHER_EXPENSE_AMT). Adds up over time.
metrics.name: Tax and Other Expense
metrics.query_description: Commercial KPI (monthly), Tax and Other Expense

metrics.description: Underwriting and acquisition expense other than commission. Definition: SUM(UNDERWRITING_EXPENSE_AMT). Adds up over time.
metrics.name: Underwriting Expense

metrics.description: Underwriting profit or loss. Definition: Net Earned Premium - Incurred Loss (current valuation) - Underwriting Expense - Net Commission. Accident-year basis like the Loss Ratio: report by the accident date.
metrics.name: Underwriting Result

metrics.description: Investment income allocated to the business. Definition: SUM(INVESTMENT_INCOME_AMT). Adds up over time.
metrics.name: Investment Income

metrics.description: Broker commission expense. Definition: SUM(NET_COMMISSION_AMT). Adds up over time.
metrics.name: Net Commission

metrics.description: Bottom-line result. Definition: Underwriting Result + Investment Income + Other Financial Revenue - Tax and Other Expense. Accident-year basis like the Loss Ratio: report by the accident date.
metrics.name: Net Result

metrics.description: Other financial revenue. Definition: SUM(OTHER_FINANCIAL_REVENUE_AMT). Adds up over time.
metrics.name: Other Financial Revenue

metrics.description: Premium taxes and other expense. Definition: SUM(TAX_AND_OTHER_EXPENSE_AMT). Adds up over time.
metrics.name: Tax and Other Expense
metrics.query_description: Commercial KPI (monthly), Tax and Other Expense

metrics.description: Underwriting and acquisition expense other than commission. Definition: SUM(UNDERWRITING_EXPENSE_AMT). Adds up over time.
metrics.name: Underwriting Expense

metrics.description: Underwriting profit or loss. Definition: Net Earned Premium - Incurred Loss (current valuation) - Underwriting Expense - Net Commission. Accident-year basis like the Loss Ratio: report by the accident date.
metrics.name: Underwriting Result

metrics.description: Claim severity. Definition: Incurred Loss / Claim Count. Ratio: compute from the totals.
metrics.name: Average Incurred per Claim
